slides.title: A mean message lands
slides.text: One afternoon a mean message lands in the class game chat, mocking a player's drawing. It is only a few words, but everyone who reads it feels smaller.
slides.alt: Game chat from JokerJay: everyone laugh at Pip, and share this so the whole school sees.

focus.cue: A mean message mocks a player
And it wants the whole school to see

slides.title: Kind words help
slides.text: Kind words help more than you think. A kind word to the player who was mocked tells them the chat is not all against them, and it costs you nothing.
slides.alt: The mean message, reported: do not join in, a kind word to Pip helps more, and save it and tell an adult.

focus.cue: A kind word to Pip helps more than any reply

slides.title: Be an upstander
slides.text: An upstander stands up for the person, kindly and safely. Never join in, never laugh along, and never forward a mean message. Forwarding spreads the hurt to new screens.
slides.alt: Lock 5, Five Moves: a message unkind to Sam is going around the class chat. Five move tiles wait to be put in order.

focus.cue: An unkind message is being passed along
Never forward it: stop, do not pass it on

slides.title: If it was you
slides.text: Sometimes the mean message came from your own fingers, sent too fast. A Defender can repair it, one honest move at a time.
steps: Delete the message if you can
Tell a trusted adult what happened
slides.alt: Would you rather delete an old post you are embarrassed by, or leave it up and laugh about it?

focus.cue: Delete the message if you can
Or leave it standing for all to see

slides.title: Save it and tell
slides.text: The move that always works: save the message, then tell a trusted adult. Saving it means the adult can see exactly what was said, and telling is never telling tales.
slides.alt: Two moves placed in order: Stop, do not pass it on, then Save it, keep the message.

focus.cue: Stop, then save it: keep the message

words.means: someone who helps the person a mean message hurt
to show a trusted adult what happened
to keep a copy of a message to show an adult

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Escape the Post Office at Lock 5: Five Moves. A mean message is going around the class chat: put the five moves in order. Your teacher may lead this one.
slides.alt: Four moves in order: Stop, Save it, Tell a trusted adult, Block or report. Carry on is the last tile.

focus.cue: Play Five Moves: put the moves in order
